Name: name that the bot listens to.
RandomChance: Chance to respond randomly is 1 in n, where n is this setting. (remove this string AND the quotes)
AddChance: Chance to add something after responding is 1 in n, where n is this setting. (remove this string AND the quotes)
Randoms: Will be randomly selected to respond with.
Custom functions can be caled by using lists, which can also contain more values.
Additives: These will be randomly added after responding based on the set chance.

Thing to listen for: respond with. will be picked at random.
